widgets.title: Failed Operations
widgets.description: Kafka/API operations that were authorised but failed at execution (data.result.status = 'FAILURE'). Examples: topic already exists, quota exceeded, invalid config. The principal had permission — the operation itself errored.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Failed Operations' FROM Log WHERE confluent.log.source = 'confluent-audit' AND data.result.status = 'FAILURE' AND (crn.environment = {{crn_environment}} OR {{crn_environment}} = 'all') AND (crn.cloud_cluster = {{crn_cluster}} OR {{crn_cluster}} = 'all') AND (crn.schema_registry = {{crn_schema_registry}} OR {{crn_schema_registry}} = 'all')

widgets.title: Schema Registry Authorizations Denied
widgets.description: Schema Registry-specific RBAC rejection (sg.server/authorization). The SR evaluated the principal's role binding (e.g. SchemaRegistryDeveloperRead) against the requested subject/schema resource and denied it. Only fires for SR API calls — not Kafka broker operations. Field: data.authorizationInfo.result = 'DENY'.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'SR Authz Denied' FROM Log WHERE confluent.log.source = 'confluent-audit' AND data.authorizationInfo.result = 'DENY' AND (crn.environment = {{crn_environment}} OR {{crn_environment}} = 'all') AND (crn.cloud_cluster = {{crn_cluster}} OR {{crn_cluster}} = 'all') AND (crn.schema_registry = {{crn_schema_registry}} OR {{crn_schema_registry}} = 'all')

widgets.title: RBAC Denied
widgets.description: Confluent RBAC rejection via the MDS (Metadata Service) broker-side check (kafka.server/authorization, method mds.Authorize). Covers all Kafka protocol operations — topics, connectors, compute pools, schema registry clusters. Fired before the broker executes the request; the principal has no role binding covering this resource and operation. Field: data.authorizationInfo.granted = 'False'.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'RBAC Denied' FROM Log WHERE confluent.log.source = 'confluent-audit' AND data.authorizationInfo.granted = 'False' AND (crn.environment = {{crn_environment}} OR {{crn_environment}} = 'all') AND (crn.cloud_cluster = {{crn_cluster}} OR {{crn_cluster}} = 'all') AND (crn.schema_registry = {{crn_schema_registry}} OR {{crn_schema_registry}} = 'all')

widgets.title: Auth Token Errors
widgets.description: Authentication soft-rejections where the token was recognised but invalid (e.g. JWT_EXPIRED). Confluent records result = 'SUCCESS' (identity resolved) but sets data.authenticationInfo.errorMessage with the real reason. Common cause: client not refreshing OAuth token before expiry.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Token Errors' FROM Log WHERE confluent.log.source = 'confluent-audit' AND data.authenticationInfo.errorMessage IS NOT NULL AND (crn.environment = {{crn_environment}} OR {{crn_environment}} = 'all') AND (crn.cloud_cluster = {{crn_cluster}} OR {{crn_cluster}} = 'all') AND (crn.schema_registry = {{crn_schema_registry}} OR {{crn_schema_registry}} = 'all')

SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE confluent.log.source = 'confluent-audit' AND (data.authorizationInfo.result = 'DENY' OR data.authorizationInfo.granted = 'False' OR data.authenticationInfo.errorMessage IS NOT NULL) AND (crn.environment = {{crn_environment}} OR {{crn_environment}} = 'all') AND (crn.cloud_cluster = {{crn_cluster}} OR {{crn_cluster}} = 'all') AND (crn.schema_registry = {{crn_schema_registry}} OR {{crn_schema_registry}} = 'all') TIMESERIES AUTO FACET cases(WHERE data.authorizationInfo.result = 'DENY' AS 'AuthZ DENY', WHERE data.authorizationInfo.granted = 'False' AS 'RBAC Denied', WHERE data.authenticationInfo.errorMessage IS NOT NULL AS 'Token Error') LIMIT 3

SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE confluent.log.source = 'confluent-audit' AND (data.result.status = {{result_status}} OR {{result_status}} = 'all') AND (crn.environment = {{crn_environment}} OR {{crn_environment}} = 'all') AND (crn.cloud_cluster = {{crn_cluster}} OR {{crn_cluster}} = 'all') AND (crn.schema_registry = {{crn_schema_registry}} OR {{crn_schema_registry}} = 'all') TIMESERIES AUTO FACET type LIMIT 20

SELECT timestamp, type, `data.methodName`, `data.result.status`, `data.result.data.errorType`, `data.result.data.message`, `data.authenticationInfo.principal`, `data.authenticationInfo.errorMessage`, `data.authorizationInfo.granted`, `data.authorizationInfo.result`, `data.authorizationInfo.operation`, `data.authorizationInfo.resourceType`, source FROM Log WHERE confluent.log.source = 'confluent-audit' AND (data.result.status = {{result_status}} OR {{result_status}} = 'all') AND (crn.environment = {{crn_environment}} OR {{crn_environment}} = 'all') AND (crn.cloud_cluster = {{crn_cluster}} OR {{crn_cluster}} = 'all') AND (crn.schema_registry = {{crn_schema_registry}} OR {{crn_schema_registry}} = 'all') LIMIT 100

SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE confluent.log.source = 'confluent-connector' AND (crn.environment = {{crn_environment}} OR {{crn_environment}} = 'all') AND (crn.connector = {{crn_connector}} OR {{crn_connector}} = 'all') TIMESERIES AUTO FACET `data.context.connectorId` LIMIT 10

SELECT timestamp, `data.context.connectorId`, `data.summary.connectorErrorSummary.message`, `data.summary.connectorErrorSummary.rootCause`, source FROM Log WHERE confluent.log.source = 'confluent-connector' AND (crn.environment = {{crn_environment}} OR {{crn_environment}} = 'all') AND (crn.connector = {{crn_connector}} OR {{crn_connector}} = 'all') LIMIT 100

nrqlQuery.query: SELECT uniques(data.result.status) FROM Log WHERE confluent.log.source = 'confluent-audit' SINCE 1 week ago
SELECT uniques(crn.environment) FROM Log WHERE confluent.log.source IN ('confluent-audit', 'confluent-connector') SINCE 1 week ago
SELECT uniques(crn.cloud_cluster) FROM Log WHERE confluent.log.source = 'confluent-audit' SINCE 1 week ago
SELECT uniques(crn.schema_registry) FROM Log WHERE confluent.log.source = 'confluent-audit' SINCE 1 week ago
SELECT uniques(crn.connector) FROM Log WHERE confluent.log.source = 'confluent-connector' SINCE 1 week ago
